skills.description: Use when the user asks to run Root Cause Analysis (RCA), debug a production incident, analyze an error log or stack trace, or trigger Steadwing. Also use when a production-style error (traceback / unhandled exception / stack trace) is surfaced and the user wants automated investigation. Handles agent registration, authentication, optional auto-detection hook setup, and RCA triggering via the Steadwing API.
